caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a wooden tool with a rounded, flattened top and a long, narrow neck that expands into a wide, bulbous base. The object is rendered in shades of brown, with darker and lighter areas suggesting the natural grain and variations in the wood. The colors include muted browns, tans, and hints of white or beige, which highlight the texture and curvature of the object. The background is an off-white or light beige, and there are no other elements or objects present in the composition. The object is centered on the paper with a shadow underneath hinting at its three-dimensional form. In the lower right corner of the drawing, the artist's name and date, "Alfred Maurer 1928", are written.
title: Pestle
